The splitter holds a VANA balance\n *         (funded by governance) and pays out of it.\n */\ncontract RewardSplitterImplementation is\n    UUPSUpgradeable,\n    PausableUpgradeable,\n    AccessControlUpgradeable,\n    ReentrancyGuardUpgradeable\n{\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n\n    bytes32 public constant MAINTAINER_ROLE = keccak256(\"MAINTAINER_ROLE\");\n    bytes32 public constant DISTRIBUTOR_ROLE = keccak256(\"DISTRIBUTOR_ROLE\");\n\n    // Burn rate is percent * 1e18 (matching maxAPY / commission), so 100% == this.\n    uint256 public constant MAX_BURN_RATE = 100e18;\n\n    // The burn cut is sent to the zero address, which permanently removes the\n    // VANA from circulation. No dedicated burn/sink address is configured.\n    address public constant BURN_ADDRESS = address(0);\n\n    IVanaPoolEntity public vanaPoolEntity;\n\n    // last principal-seconds reading taken for an entity (the round baseline)\n    mapping(uint256 entityId => uint256 principalSeconds) public baseline;\n    // whether an entity has been seen before (distinguishes \"baseline 0\" from unset)\n    mapping(uint256 entityId => bool) public seen;\n\n    // Burn: this fraction of each distributed budget is set aside before the\n    // remainder is split across entities. distribute() only accrues it into\n    // pendingBurn; executeBurn() sends it to BURN_ADDRESS (the zero address).\n    uint256 public burnRate; // percent * 1e18; 0 = no burn\n    uint256 public pendingBurn; // wei accrued for burning, not yet sent\n\n    // --- ERC-20 reward inlet (appended; append-safe for UUPS) ---\n    // There is no on-chain swap. ERC-20 rewards are funded here, handed to a\n    // trusted off-chain converter, and returned as native VANA (via receive())\n    // to be distributed by the existing native path. pendingConversion is the\n    // record of tokens held but not yet sent to the converter.\n    address public converter;\n    mapping(address token => uint256 amount) public pendingConversion;\n\n    // Whether entity payouts pay the entity owner's commission cut. Passed to\n    // addStakerRewards, which vests to delegators and (when true) skims the owner's\n    // cut up front at the current rate. Governance-toggled.\n    bool public payEntityCommission;\n\n    // Linear vesting span (seconds) for each entity payout on the entity's\n    // owner-proof splitter track. Must be set explicitly before distributing;\n    // there is no default, so a payout can never be an unintended instant release.\n    uint32 public rewardVestingDuration;\n\n    event Distributed(uint256 indexed entityId, uint256 amount, uint256 weight);\n    event RoundDistributed(uint256 budget, uint256 totalWeight, uint256 entityCount);\n    event BurnAccrued(uint256 amount, uint256 pendingBurn);\n    event Burned(uint256 amount);\n    event BurnRateUpdated(uint256 burnRate);\n    event PayEntityCommissionUpdated(bool value);\n    event RewardVestingDurationUpdated(uint32 duration);\n    event Funded(address indexed from, uint256 amount);\n    event Withdrawn(address indexed to, uint256 amount);\n    event ConverterUpdated(address indexed converter);\n    event TokenRewardFunded(address indexed token, address indexed from, uint256 amount);\n    event SentToConverter(address indexed token, address indexed to, uint256 amount);\n    event TokenRecovered(address indexed token, address indexed to, uint256 amount);\n\n    error InvalidAddress();\n    error InvalidBudget();\n    error InvalidBurnRate();\n    error TransferFailed();\n    error InvalidAmount();\n    error VestingDurationNotSet();\n\n    /// @custom:oz-upgrades-unsafe-allow constructor\n    constructor() {\n        _disableInitializers();\n    }\n\n    function initialize(address ownerAddress, address vanaPoolEntityAddress) external initializer {\n        __AccessControl_init();\n        __UUPSUpgradeable_init();\n        __Pausable_init();\n        __ReentrancyGuard_init();\n\n        if (ownerAddress == address(0) || vanaPoolEntityAddress == address(0)) {\n            revert InvalidAddress();\n        }\n\n        vanaPoolEntity = IVanaPoolEntity(vanaPoolEntityAddress);\n        payEntityCommission = true; // default: pay the entity owner's commission cut\n\n        _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, ownerAddress);\n        _grantRole(MAINTAINER_ROLE, ownerAddress);\n        _grantRole(DISTRIBUTOR_ROLE, ownerAddress);\n    }\n\n    function _authorizeUpgrade(address newImplementation) internal virtual override onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) {}\n\n    /// @notice Fund the splitter's distributable balance.\n    receive() external payable {\n        // A zero-value call funds nothing: emit only for real funding so the\n        // event cannot be spammed for free (NM-1052 [Best Practice]).\n        if (msg.value > 0) {\n            emit Funded(msg.sender, msg.value);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Fund an ERC-20 reward. Pulls `amount` of `token` from the caller\n     *         (who must have approved this contract) and records it in\n     *         pendingConversion. There is no on-chain swap: the tokens wait here\n     *         until a maintainer forwards them to the converter, which swaps them\n     *         off-chain and returns native VANA to receive() for distribution.\n     *         Permissionless, mirroring the native receive() inlet.\n     * @param token  ERC-20 reward token\n     * @param amount amount to pull from the caller\n     */\n    function fundTokenReward(address token, uint256 amount) external nonReentrant whenNotPaused {\n        if (token == address(0)) {\n            revert InvalidAddress();\n        }\n        if (amount == 0) {\n            revert InvalidAmount();\n        }\n        // Record exactly what arrives, so fee-on-transfer tokens can't leave\n        // pendingConversion overstating the real balance.\n        uint256 balanceBefore = IERC20(token).balanceOf(address(this));\n        IERC20(token).safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);\n        uint256 received = IERC20(token).balanceOf(address(this)) - balanceBefore;\n\n        pendingConversion[token] += received;\n        emit TokenRewardFunded(token, msg.sender, received);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Set the trusted converter that swaps ERC-20 rewards to VANA\n    ///         off-chain and returns the VANA to this contract.\n    function updateConverter(address newConverter) external onlyRole(MAINTAINER_ROLE) {\n        if (newConverter == address(0)) {\n            revert InvalidAddress();\n        }\n        converter = newConverter;\n        emit ConverterUpdated(newConverter);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Forward recorded ERC-20 rewards to the converter for off-chain\n     *         swapping to VANA. The converter is trusted to return native VANA to\n     *         receive(); this contract holds no on-chain guarantee it will, so\n     *         only a maintainer may call, and only to the configured converter.\n     * @param token  ERC-20 reward token\n     * @param amount amount to forward (<= pendingConversion[token])\n     */\n    function sendToConverter(address token, uint256 amount) external onlyRole(MAINTAINER_ROLE) nonReentrant {\n        if (converter == address(0)) {\n            revert InvalidAddress();\n        }\n        if (amount == 0) {\n            revert InvalidAmount();\n        }\n        if (amount > pendingConversion[token]) {\n            revert InvalidBudget();\n        }\n        pendingConversion[token] -= amount; // effects before interaction\n        IERC20(token).safeTransfer(converter, amount);\n        emit SentToConverter(token, converter, amount);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Split `budget` across `entityIds` by their principal-seconds accrued\n     *         since the previous distribution (the delta from each entity's\n     *         baseline -- absolute principal-seconds would re-pay all past rounds\n     *         and let old/empty pools dominate). A first-seen entity only has its\n     *         baseline recorded (it earns from the next round); flash stake\n     *         integrates to ~0 weight; only a pool's own stakers can reduce its\n     *         weight, so no third party can skew the split. The weight tracks\n     *         committed principal, not pool value, so it cannot be inflated by\n     *         timing processRewards calls (settlement-invariant).\n     *\n     * @param budget      wei to distribute (<= the splitter's balance)\n     * @param entityIds   entities to split across\n     */\n    function distribute(\n        uint256 budget,\n        uint256[] calldata entityIds\n    ) external onlyRole(DISTRIBUTOR_ROLE) nonReentrant whenNotPaused {\n        // The vesting duration must be set explicitly; no default, so a payout is\n        // never an unintended instant release.\n        if (rewardVestingDuration == 0) {\n            revert VestingDurationNotSet();\n        }\n        // pendingBurn is reserved; a distribution can only use the free balance.\n        if (budget == 0 || budget > address(this).balance - pendingBurn) {\n            revert InvalidBudget();\n        }\n\n        uint256 n = entityIds.length;\n        uint256[] memory current = new uint256[](n);\n        uint256[] memory weights = new uint256[](n);\n        uint256 totalWeight;\n\n        // Pass 1: read each entity's cumulative principal-seconds; its weight is\n        // the growth since the last distribution (its baseline).\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            uint256 id = entityIds[i];\n            uint256 s = vanaPoolEntity.principalSecondsAt(id);\n            current[i] = s;\n\n            if (!seen[id]) {\n                seen[id] = true; // first sight: baseline only, weight 0 (earns next round)\n                weights[i] = 0;\n            } else {\n                weights[i] = s - baseline[id]; // monotone, so never underflows\n                totalWeight += weights[i];\n            }\n        }\n\n        // No weight yet (all first-seen, or no accrual): just roll baselines forward.\n        if (totalWeight == 0) {\n            for (uint256 i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n                baseline[entityIds[i]] = current[i];\n            }\n            emit RoundDistributed(budget, 0, n);\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // Burn: set aside a cut of the budget before the entity split. Only\n        // accrued here (no transfer); sent to the burn address by executeBurn.\n        uint256 burnAmount = burnRate > 0 ? (budget * burnRate) / MAX_BURN_RATE : 0;\n        uint256 entityBudget = budget - burnAmount;\n        if (burnAmount > 0) {\n            pendingBurn += burnAmount;\n            emit BurnAccrued(burnAmount, pendingBurn);\n        }\n\n        // Pass 2: advance baselines and pay each entity its pro-rata share of the\n        // entity budget. Dust from integer division stays for the next round.\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            uint256 id = entityIds[i];\n            baseline[id] = current[i];\n\n            if (weights[i] == 0) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            uint256 share = (entityBudget * weights[i]) / totalWeight;\n            if (share == 0) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            // Pay the entity's stakers on the owner-proof track: vests over\n            // rewardVestingDuration; the entity owner cannot withhold or re-rate it.\n            vanaPoolEntity.addStakerRewards{value: share}(id, payEntityCommission, rewardVestingDuration);\n            emit Distributed(id, share, weights[i]);\n        }\n\n        emit RoundDistributed(budget, totalWeight, n);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice The weight an entity would receive right now (principal-seconds\n     *         since its baseline). 0 for a first-seen entity.\n     */\n    function pendingWeight(uint256 entityId) external view returns (uint256) {\n        if (!seen[entityId]) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        return vanaPoolEntity.principalSecondsAt(entityId) - baseline[entityId];\n    }\n\n    function updateVanaPoolEntity(address newVanaPoolEntityAddress) external onlyRole(MAINTAINER_ROLE) {\n        if (newVanaPoolEntityAddress == address(0)) {\n            revert InvalidAddress();\n        }\n        vanaPoolEntity = IVanaPoolEntity(newVanaPoolEntityAddress);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Set the burn cut skimmed from each distributed budget. The skim is\n     *         sent to the zero address (BURN_ADDRESS), so no recipient is needed.\n     * @param newBurnRate percent * 1e18 (0..MAX_BURN_RATE); 0 disables\n     */\n    function updateBurnRate(uint256 newBurnRate) external onlyRole(MAINTAINER_ROLE) {\n        if (newBurnRate > MAX_BURN_RATE) {\n            revert InvalidBurnRate();\n        }\n        burnRate = newBurnRate;\n        emit BurnRateUpdated(newBurnRate);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Toggle whether entity payouts pay the entity owner's commission cut.\n    function updatePayEntityCommission(bool value) external onlyRole(MAINTAINER_ROLE) {\n        payEntityCommission = value;\n        emit PayEntityCommissionUpdated(value);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Set the linear vesting span (seconds) applied to each entity payout.\n    ///         Must be explicitly set (> 0) before distributing.\n    function updateRewardVestingDuration(uint32 duration) external onlyRole(MAINTAINER_ROLE) {\n        if (duration == 0) {\n            revert VestingDurationNotSet();\n        }\n        rewardVestingDuration = duration;\n        emit RewardVestingDurationUpdated(duration);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Send the accrued burn balance to the zero address, permanently\n     *         removing it from circulation. Permissionless: funds only ever go\n     *         to BURN_ADDRESS. No-op when nothing has accrued.\n     */\n    function executeBurn() external nonReentrant {\n        uint256 amount = pendingBurn;\n        if (amount == 0) {\n            return;\n        }\n        pendingBurn = 0; // effects before interaction\n        (bool burned, ) = BURN_ADDRESS.call{value: amount}(\"\");\n        if (!burned) {\n            revert TransferFailed();\n        }\n        emit Burned(amount);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Recover unallocated VANA (division dust or excess funding). Cannot\n    ///         touch the pendingBurn reserve.\n    function withdraw(address payable to, uint256 amount) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) nonReentrant {\n        if (to == address(0)) {\n            revert InvalidAddress();\n        }\n        if (amount > address(this).balance - pendingBurn) {\n            revert InvalidBudget();\n        }\n        (bool success, ) = to.call{value: amount}(\"\");\n        if (!success) {\n            revert TransferFailed();\n        }\n        emit Withdrawn(to, amount);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Recover ERC-20 not part of a recorded reward -- tokens airdropped\n    ///         or sent directly rather than via fundTokenReward. Cannot touch the\n    ///         pendingConversion reserve, which must exit through sendToConverter.\n    function recoverToken(\n        address token,\n        address to,\n        uint256 amount\n    ) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) nonReentrant {\n        if (to == address(0)) {\n            revert InvalidAddress();\n        }\n        uint256 recoverable = IERC20(token).balanceOf(address(this)) - pendingConversion[token];\n        if (amount > recoverable) {\n            revert InvalidBudget();\n        }\n        IERC20(token).safeTransfer(to, amount);\n        emit TokenRecovered(token, to, amount);\n    }\n\n    function pause() external onlyRole(MAINTAINER_ROLE) {\n        _pause();\n    }\n\n    function unpause() external onlyRole(MAINTAINER_ROLE) {\n        _unpause();\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x8f2a01a9f98f86b3c026ade6987f8f640766ad4ff4d565b663dbaaf3dccb300a","license":"Apache-2.0"},"contracts/vanaStaking/vanaPoolEntity/interfaces/IVanaPoolEntity.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.24;\n\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/structs/EnumerableSet.sol\";\nimport {IVanaPoolStaking} from \"../../vanaPoolStaking/interfaces/IVanaPoolStaking.sol\";\n\ninterface IVanaPoolEntity {\n    enum EntityStatus {\n        None,\n        Active,\n        Removed\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Selects how an entity vests rewards from lockedRewardPool into\n    ///         activeRewardPool. APY is the original continuous-compounding\n    ///         drip (rate = active * (e^(maxAPY*dt) - 1)); STREAM is a\n    ///         Synthetix-style linear schedule (rate = scheduledValue / duration).\n    ///         Default 0 == APY, so an upgrade leaves every existing entity on\n    ///         its current behaviour until a maintainer switches it.\n    enum RewardModel {\n        APY,\n        STREAM\n    }\n\n    /// @notice A linear reward stream for an entity in STREAM mode. Holds one\n    ///         active entry plus a single queued follow-on entry that becomes\n    ///         active automatically when the active one ends (Synthetix V3\n    ///         RewardDistribution semantics). All amounts are in wei; the funds\n    ///         backing them live in the entity's lockedRewardPool.\n    struct RewardSchedule {\n        // slot 0 (256 bits, fully packed)\n        uint128 scheduledValue; // active entry: total to vest over [start, start+duration]\n        uint64 start; // active entry: vesting start; <= now vests immediately when duration == 0\n        uint32 duration; // active entry: vesting span in seconds; 0 == instant\n        uint32 nextDuration; // queued entry: vesting span in seconds\n        // slot 1 (256 bits, fully packed)\n        uint128 nextScheduledValue; // queued entry: total, or 0 if nothing queued\n        uint64 nextStart; // queued entry: vesting start (>= active entry's end)\n        uint64 lastUpdate; // watermark: last time the active entry was vested; uint64 to match `start` (no 2106 truncation)\n    }\n\n    struct Entity {\n        address ownerAddress;\n        EntityStatus status;\n        string name;\n        uint256 maxAPY; // Maximum APY for this entity (in basis points, 1% = 100)\n        uint256 lockedRewardPool; // Locked rewards for this entity\n        uint256 activeRewardPool; // Active rewards available for distribution\n        uint256 totalShares; // Total shares for this entity\n        uint256 lastUpdateTimestamp; // When rewards were last processed\n        uint256 totalDistributedRewards; // Cumulative rewards distributed from locked to active pool\n        // --- appended in the rewards-models upgrade; safe because Entity is\n        //     only ever held in the _entities mapping (per-key base slot) ---\n        RewardModel rewardModel; // APY (0, default) or STREAM\n        RewardSchedule rewardSchedule; // only used while rewardModel == STREAM\n        // --- appended in the commission upgrade; append-safe as above ---\n        uint256 commissionRate; // operator cut of each distribution, percent * 1e18 (100% = 100e18); default 0\n        uint256 accruedCommission; // wei owed to the entity owner, not yet claimed\n        // --- appended in the principal-seconds upgrade; append-safe as above ---\n        // Weight metric for the cross-entity reward split. Integrates COMMITTED\n        // PRINCIPAL (not activeRewardPool) over time, so it is invariant to when\n        // processRewards is called: settling vested rewards early can no longer\n        // inflate an entity's weight. Only real stake / unstake / redelegate move\n        // stakedPrincipal, and flash movements integrate to ~0.\n        uint256 stakedPrincipal; // VANA principal currently delegated (settlement-invariant)\n        uint256 principalSeconds; // cumulative integral of stakedPrincipal over time (monotone)\n        uint256 principalSecondsUpdatedAt; // last time principalSeconds was checkpointed\n        // --- appended in the stake-block upgrade; append-safe as above ---\n        bool stakingBlocked; // when true, no new stake may enter (stake / redelegate-in); unstake and redelegate-out stay open\n        // --- appended in the sweep upgrade; append-safe as above ---\n        uint256 sweepableAfter; // 0 = sweep disabled; else the timestamp from which unallocated APY rewards may be swept\n        // --- appended in the two-phase-commission upgrade; append-safe as above ---\n        uint256 pendingCommissionRate; // 0 = none; else a proposed rate INCREASE awaiting maintainer approval\n        // --- appended in the splitter-reward-track upgrade; append-safe as above ---\n        // Dedicated, owner-proof track for externally-funded (splitter) rewards.\n        // Kept OUT of lockedRewardPool so the owner-controlled APY/STREAM drip,\n        // sweep, distributeRewards and switchToStreamModel can never reach it.\n        // Funded only by addStakerRewards; vested linearly to delegators by\n        // processRewards on the schedule below.\n        uint256 stakerLockedRewardPool; // splitter rewards not yet vested to delegators\n        RewardSchedule stakerRewardSchedule; // linear vesting entry for the splitter track\n    }\n\n    function version() external pure returns (uint256);\n    function vanaPoolStaking() external view returns (IVanaPoolStaking);\n    function minRegistrationStake() external view returns (uint256);\n    function maxAPYDefault() external view returns (uint256);\n\n    struct EntityInfo {\n        uint256 entityId;\n        address ownerAddress;\n        EntityStatus status;\n        string name;\n        uint256 maxAPY;\n        uint256 lockedRewardPool;\n        uint256 activeRewardPool;\n        uint256 totalShares;\n        uint256 lastUpdateTimestamp;\n        uint256 totalDistributedRewards;\n    }\n\n    function entitiesCount() external view returns (uint256);\n    function entities(uint256 entityId) external view returns (EntityInfo memory);\n    function entityByName(string calldata entityName) external view returns (EntityInfo memory);\n\n    function entityRewardModel(uint256 entityId) external view returns (RewardModel);\n    function entityRewardSchedule(uint256 entityId) external view returns (RewardSchedule memory);\n    function entityStakerLockedRewardPool(uint256 entityId) external view returns (uint256);\n    function entityStakerRewardSchedule(uint256 entityId) external view returns (RewardSchedule memory);\n    function committedRewards(uint256 entityId) external view returns (uint256);\n    // activeRewardPool as it will stand right after processRewards (actual reward\n    // model, commission, splitter track); the one source for settlement quotes.\n    function previewActiveRewardPool(uint256 entityId) external view returns (uint256);\n    function principalSecondsAt(uint256 entityId) external view returns (uint256);\n    function checkpointPrincipal(uint256 entityId) external; // permissionless; seeds a legacy entity on first call\n    function entityNameToId(string calldata entityName) external view returns (uint256);\n\n    function entityShareToVana(uint256 entityId) external view returns (uint256);\n    function vanaToEntityShare(uint256 entityId) external view returns (uint256);\n    // Shares minted for `vanaAmount`, in a SINGLE division so truncation lands on\n    // the last wei of the result (<= 1 wei-share) rather than on the rate.\n    function vanaToShares(uint256 entityId, uint256 vanaAmount) external view returns (uint256);\n    function sharesToVana(uint256 entityId, uint256 shares) external view returns (uint256);\n\n    function entitySweepableAfter(uint256 entityId) external view returns (uint256);\n    function updateEntitySweepableAfter(uint256 entityId, uint256 timestamp) external;\n    function sweepUnallocatedRewards(uint256 entityId, address payable to) external;\n\n    function pause() external;\n    function unpause() external;\n    function updateVanaPool(address newVanaPoolStakingAddress) external;\n    // The RewardSplitter holding REWARD_SPLITTER_ROLE, and the first-class wiring\n    // that grants it (revoking the previous one).\n    function rewardSplitter() external view returns (address);\n    function updateRewardSplitter(address newRewardSplitter) external;\n    function updateMinRegistrationStake(uint256 newMinRegistrationStake) external;\n\n    struct EntityRegistrationInfo {\n        address ownerAddress;\n        string name;\n    }\n\n    function createEntity(EntityRegistrationInfo calldata entityRegistrationInfo) external payable;\n    function createEntity(EntityRegistrationInfo calldata entityRegistrationInfo, RewardModel model) external payable;\n    function updateEntity(uint256 entityId, EntityRegistrationInfo calldata entityRegistrationInfo) external;\n    //    function removeEntity(uint256 entityId) external;\n\n    // Entity reward management\n    function addRewards(uint256 entityId) external payable;\n    // Externally-funded, delegator-earned rewards (from the RewardSplitter): vested\n    // to delegators over `duration` on a dedicated, owner-proof track; payCommission\n    // skims the owner's cut up front at the current rate. Overlapping calls rebase\n    // (remaining unvested + new amount re-vest over a fresh window). Never touches\n    // the owner's lockedRewardPool/schedule, so the owner cannot withhold or re-rate it.\n    function addStakerRewards(uint256 entityId, bool payCommission, uint32 duration) external payable;\n    function processRewards(uint256 entityId) external;\n\n    function distributeRewards(uint256 entityId, uint256 amount, uint64 start, uint32 duration) external payable;\n    function topUpQueuedRewards(uint256 entityId) external payable;\n    function updateEntityMaxAPY(uint256 entityId, uint256 newMaxAPY) external;\n\n    function switchToStreamModel(uint256 entityId, uint64 start, uint32 duration) external;\n\n    function updateEntityCommission(uint256 entityId, uint256 newCommissionRate) external; // decreases only\n    function proposeCommissionRate(uint256 entityId, uint256 newCommissionRate) external; // increases: owner proposes\n    function approveCommissionRate(uint256 entityId, uint256 expectedRate) external; // increases: maintainer approves exactly `expectedRate` (must equal the pending proposal)\n    function claimCommission(uint256 entityId) external;\n    function entityCommissionRate(uint256 entityId) external view returns (uint256);\n    function entityPendingCommissionRate(uint256 entityId) external view returns (uint256);\n    function entityAccruedCommission(uint256 entityId) external view returns (uint256);\n\n    function updateEntityStakingBlocked(uint256 entityId, bool blocked) external;\n    function entityStakingBlocked(uint256 entityId) external view returns (bool);\n\n    // Get entities\n    function activeEntitiesValues() external view returns (uint256[] memory);\n\n    function updateEntityPool(uint256 entityId, uint256 shares, uint256 amount, bool isStake) external;\n    function returnForfeitedRewards(uint256 entityId, uint256 amount) external;\n    function redelegateDistributedRewards(uint256 fromEntityId, uint256 toEntityId, uint256 amount) external;\n\n    // Parameter order matches the implementation (principal first): all three are\n    // uint256, so a transposed declaration compiles and silently returns nonsense.\n    function calculateYield(uint256 principal, uint256 apy, uint256 time) external pure returns (uint256);\n\n    function calculateContinuousAPYByEntity(uint256 entityId) external view returns (uint256);\n\n    function currentAPYByEntity(uint256 entityId) external view returns (uint256);\n}\n","keccak256":"0x0be905a998e3ca958214c1b3bfa58551c26929769b7d781fe48428c1e6989dda","license":"MIT"},"contracts/vanaStaking/vanaPoolStaking/interfaces/IVanaPoolStaking.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.24;\n\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/structs/EnumerableSet.sol\";\nimport {IVanaPoolEntity} from proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `callerConfirmation`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

distribute(uint256,uint256[]).notice: Split `budget` across `entityIds` by their principal-seconds accrued         since the previous distribution (the delta from each entity's         baseline -- absolute principal-seconds would re-pay all past rounds         and let old/empty pools dominate). A first-seen entity only has its         baseline recorded (it earns from the next round); flash stake         integrates to ~0 weight; only a pool's own stakers can reduce its         weight, so no third party can skew the split. The weight tracks         committed principal, not pool value, so it cannot be inflated by         timing processRewards calls (settlement-invariant).

executeBurn().notice: Send the accrued burn balance to the zero address, permanently         removing it from circulation. Permissionless: funds only ever go         to BURN_ADDRESS. No-op when nothing has accrued.

fundTokenReward(address,uint256).notice: Fund an ERC-20 reward. Pulls `amount` of `token` from the caller         (who must have approved this contract) and records it in         pendingConversion. There is no on-chain swap: the tokens wait here         until a maintainer forwards them to the converter, which swaps them         off-chain and returns native VANA to receive() for distribution.         Permissionless, mirroring the native receive() inlet.

pendingWeight(uint256).notice: The weight an entity would receive right now (principal-seconds         since its baseline). 0 for a first-seen entity.

recoverToken(address,address,uint256).notice: Recover ERC-20 not part of a recorded reward -- tokens airdropped         or sent directly rather than via fundTokenReward. Cannot touch the         pendingConversion reserve, which must exit through sendToConverter.

sendToConverter(address,uint256).notice: Forward recorded ERC-20 rewards to the converter for off-chain         swapping to VANA. The converter is trusted to return native VANA to         receive(); this contract holds no on-chain guarantee it will, so         only a maintainer may call, and only to the configured converter.

updateBurnRate(uint256).notice: Set the burn cut skimmed from each distributed budget. The skim is         sent to the zero address (BURN_ADDRESS), so no recipient is needed.

updateConverter(address).notice: Set the trusted converter that swaps ERC-20 rewards to VANA         off-chain and returns the VANA to this contract.

updatePayEntityCommission(bool).notice: Toggle whether entity payouts pay the entity owner's commission cut.

updateRewardVestingDuration(uint32).notice: Set the linear vesting span (seconds) applied to each entity payout.         Must be explicitly set (> 0) before distributing.

withdraw(address,uint256).notice: Recover unallocated VANA (division dust or excess funding). Cannot         touch the pendingBurn reserve.

userdoc.notice: Splits a VANA reward budget across VanaPool entities in proportion to         their principal-seconds accrued since the previous distribution -- i.e.         by committed principal over time (settlement-invariant: vesting rewards         into a pool via processRewards does not change its weight), not a         snapshot and not pool value. Each entity's share is paid         via addRewards, so the entity then vests it to its own stakers under         its own model (APY or STREAM). The splitter holds a VANA balance         (funded by governance) and pays out of it.
